newsitem.title: USA: U.S Northwest spot products flat with Calif. late.
newsitem.headline: U.S Northwest spot products flat with Calif. late.

text.p: U.S. Northwest spot product prices were notionally unchanged from Thursday, tracking a balanced supply/demand picture and stability in California markets.
California regular unleaded gasoline rose two cents to 62.50/63.50 cents a gallon while CARB grade gasolines rose a cent to 67.50/68.50 cents.
But afternoon trade faded ahead of the weekend, and prices turned idle.
In Seattle, regular unleaded gasoline was assessed unchanged at 63/64 cents a gallon, flat from Thursday.
Jet fuel in Seattle remained 75.50/76.50 cents a gallon, holding after a dip yesterday following the arrival of two cargoes intoLos Angeles market.
Low sulphur diesel remained 74/75 cents a gallon.
